''See also: [[Intent Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Intent is a fundamental power of focused will possessed by all humans. It is an inescapable force that people use subconsciously in their daily lives. When a person uses a tool or object, they perform a process called investing, which involves lending a portion of their Intent to that item. Over time, this accumulation of energy improves the object's ability to perform its intended function, such as a knife becoming sharper or a coat providing more warmth. While most people invest Intent blindly, specialized individuals known as [[Readers]] can consciously observe and manipulate the Intent stored within physical structures. This ability allows [[Readers]] to investigate objects, craft superior tools, and sense the emotions or backgrounds of others through their active Intent. Intent can be layered with complex meanings and emotions, reflecting the character of its source. Through a process called [[Awakening]], a Reader can transform an invested object into an Awakened item. These objects gain a rudimentary form of consciousness related to their original purpose and can utilize their stored Intent to achieve specific goals, though they no longer accumulate new Intent once Awakened. Because Intent is tied to purpose, understanding an object's underlying goals is essential for a Reader to master its eventual powers. Intent can also be felt in environments or crowds, though it can sometimes be scrambled, diluted, or even used to influence a person's mental state.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Intent is a property carried within the structure of objects, such as wood, copper poles, or doors, that can be improved by lending it to an item over time. This focused purpose can be invested into objects or flowed into materials like wood to issue orders, and it is even used by [[Readers]] as a function for memory storage. While individuals like [[Calder]] and [[Jerri]] can focus their own Intent, others such as [[Naberius Clayborn]] produce flows of malicious or great Intent. This essence can be sensed through the air, read from paper to understand a person's emotions and background, or even felt as impressions on rocks and remains. Ultimately, Intent can manifest in powerful forms, ranging from the ancient, infinite Intent within the Heart to the absolute [[Authority|authority]] [[Calder]] exerts when using the Emperor's crown.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Intent is a property of focused will possessed by all humans and is utilized subconsciously by everyone. This human quality can be invested into various objects, such as spoons, knives, or spiked [[chains]], to enhance their reliability, sharpness, or general abilities. For example, the Bones of the [[Dead Mother]]'s [[Children]] are invested with power similarly to an object holding Intent, and [[Shera]] carries a blade with a palpable weight of Intent that appears blinding to a Reader. Through the process of [[Reading]], this force can be sensed and manipulated, though it can also be used by a Reader to cause harm or undergo degradation.}}

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Intent is a powerful force that can leak from weapons, stain objects like an atmospheric presence, and serve as the greatest weapon for a [[Magister]]. While it can be sensed through [[Reading]] or felt when attempting to examine an object, interpreting a situation's Intent remains a risky endeavor. [[Calder]] demonstrates mastery over this power by commanding the [[Lyathatan]], moving his Intent through [[chains]], and letting it drift through buildings. During his investigations, [[Calder]] detects a strange wisp of unusual Intent within the [[Emperor's personal rooms|Emperor's chambers]], just as [[Lucan]]'s own Intent revealed a peaceful readiness for death. Ultimately, this force can be magnified by the [[Optasia]], used to tear ropes through intense concentration, and serves as a language utilized by [[Great Elders]].}}

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Intent is a projected power or mental state that can be mustered to manipulate objects, exert physical force, or even raise [[Alagaeus]]'s castle. While it functions as a subtle radiation that [[Readers]] can sense, the Emperor possesses the unique ability to read Intent within even the flimsiest objects, and [[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] has explored its possibilities extensively. This power can be used to warp [[steel]], break relay connections, block weapons, or lock hands in place, though it requires careful control. Various individuals demonstrate unique connections to this force, such as [[Lucan]] reading ambient Intent, [[Jyrine Tessella Marten|Jyrine]] possessing speed faster than the [[Imperial Guards]], and [[Shera]] using her Intent to create [[Bastion's Veil]]. While [[Soulbound]] may tear the power from a [[Magister]], rumors persist among [[Consultants]] regarding what becomes of Intent after death.}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Intent is a force capable of paralyzing thoughts and can be found within the Steward's crown or left behind by the belongings of an Emperor. Through a process called Investment, an object's performance improves based on the focus, strength, and quantity of reinforcing Intent, which can be magnified by a network of earthbound devices. While plants only store this force when utilized by a person, it can also manifest as an invisible surge to seal doors and windows or pulse within a diamond. Intent serves as one of the three sources used in the [[Awakening]] process and can connect to a user through a [[Soulbound Vessel]], though its presence in complex machinery is treated as a collection of parts. The strength of one's Intent determines the division of possession, and while it is a measurable force, it remains more quantifiable than the concept of [[Significance]] used in [[Reading]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">14</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Steward's crown contains [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c2">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Emperor's belongings leave behind a weight and intensity of [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c4">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Intent]] can paralyze thoughts.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c6">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Investment is the process where an object performs better based on the strength, focus, and quantity of reinforcing [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c7">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Plants only store [[Intent]] if a person uses them for something.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c8">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Intent]] is magnified by a network of earthbound devices.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c9">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|An invisible surge of [[Intent]] sealed every door and window on the Emperor's Stage.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The diamond in the [[White Sun medallion]] pulses with [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 17</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Intent]] is one of the three sources used in the [[Awakening]] process.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Complex machinery interacts with [[Intent]] as a collection of parts rather than a single object.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c18">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 18</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|A [[Soulbound Vessel]] may connect to a user's [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c18" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Lyathatan]]'s [[Intent]] is a mix of rage, patience, malice, pragmatism, [[hunger]], and desires.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c22">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 22</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The division of possession depends on the strength of one's [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 24</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Significance]] is a concept in [[Reading]] that is more difficult to quantify than [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 25</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Intent is a multi-layered property that objects can possess, which serves as a medium that certain [[Readers]] can sense through taste or by opening their senses. While it can be invested into items like smoke bombs, battering rams, or blades to accomplish amazing things over time, breaking through its [[binding|bindings]] requires considerable power. This essence can be radiated or used to reach others, as seen when [[Shera]] reaches [[Kell’arack|Kelalrac]], though its presence can distract [[Gardeners]]. The Emperor demonstrated his strength by using his own power to break the [[binding]] of [[Estyr]]'s Intent, and such forces can even cause the air to crackle when they clash.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">13</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Breaking through [[Intent]] requires considerable power.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c2">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Intent]] is a medium that can be radiated and read by certain [[Readers]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c3">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 3</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Emperor could break the [[binding]] of [[Estyr]]'s [[Intent]] with his own.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c3" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Intent]] can be bound up in a blade or invested in objects like battering rams.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c5">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Intent]] can accomplish amazing things given enough time.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c5" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Lucan]] sensed weak [[Intent]] from the black linen bag.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c11">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Intent]] is something that can be tasted by opening one's senses.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c11" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Intent]] is a property that objects can possess which attracts [[Readers]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Intent]] has many layers beneath the surface.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[smoke bomb]] had a lot of [[Intent]] invested into it.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c19">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 19</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Gardeners]] are more effective when not distracted by [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 22</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The air between the [[Great Elder]] and [[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] crackled with the clash of [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 23</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Shera]] can reach [[Kell’arack|Kelalrac]] using her [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 26</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
